entries.regex: model type `([^`]+)` but Transformers does not recognize this architecture

title.zh: 镜像中的 Transformers 不认识模型类型 {1}
title.en: Transformers in this image does not know model type {1}

hint.zh: 运行预检探针，或换用更新的运行时镜像。
hint.en: Run the dry probe, or use a newer runtime image.

explanation.zh: 检查点比运行时镜像新，或需要自定义建模代码。
explanation.en: The checkpoint is newer than the runtime image, or it needs custom modeling code.

title.zh: llama.cpp 不认识模型架构 {1}
title.en: llama.cpp does not know model architecture {1}

hint.zh: 换用支持该架构的更新 llama.cpp 镜像，或改用其他引擎。
hint.en: Use a newer llama.cpp image that supports this architecture, or another engine.

explanation.zh: GGUF 声明的架构不在当前 llama.cpp 构建的支持列表中。
explanation.en: The architecture declared by the GGUF is not supported by this llama.cpp build.

entries.regex: failed to allocate (CUDA\d+) buffer of size (\d+)

title.zh: {1} 显存缓冲区分配失败（{2} 字节）
title.en: Failed to allocate a {1} buffer of {2} bytes

hint.zh: 减少放在 GPU 上的层数或把 MoE 专家放到 CPU，或降低上下文长度。
hint.en: Put fewer layers on the GPU or keep MoE experts on the CPU, or lower the context length.

explanation.zh: 模型权重或缓冲区超过所选 GPU 的可用显存。
explanation.en: The weights or buffers do not fit into the free memory of the selected GPU.

entries.regex: (?:larger than the maximum number of tokens that can be stored in KV cache|No available memory for the cache blocks|larger than the available KV cache memory)

title.zh: KV cache 放不下单个请求的最大上下文
title.en: The KV cache cannot hold one request at the maximum context

hint.zh: 降低上下文长度或并发数，或改用 FP8 KV cache。
hint.en: Lower the context length or concurrency, or use an FP8 KV cache.

explanation.zh: 权重加载后剩余显存不足以容纳最大上下文的 KV cache。
explanation.en: After the weights are loaded, the remaining memory cannot hold the KV cache for the maximum context.

title.zh: Mamba cache align 要求更大的调度 token 上限
title.en: Mamba cache align needs a larger scheduling token limit

hint.zh: 这是 Qwen3.6 混合/Mamba cache align 下的调度 token 上限过低；把 --max-num-batched-tokens 提高到 8192 后重试。
hint.en: The scheduling token limit is too low for hybrid/Mamba cache align (Qwen3.6); raise --max-num-batched-tokens to 8192 and retry.

explanation.zh: Mamba cache align 断言：max_num_batched_tokens 太小，Qwen3.6 MoE/NVFP4 用 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 后重试。
explanation.en: Mamba cache align assertion: max_num_batched_tokens is too small; retry Qwen3.6 MoE/NVFP4 with --max-num-batched-tokens 8192.

title.zh: ModelOpt 权重布局与当前 vLLM 加载器不匹配
title.en: The ModelOpt weight layout does not match this vLLM loader

hint.zh: 这是 Qwen3.6/NVFP4 的 ModelOpt 权重布局与当前 vLLM 加载器不匹配；优先换 vllm/vllm-openai:nightly 或模型卡指定的 vLLM 版本。
hint.en: The Qwen3.6/NVFP4 ModelOpt weight layout does not match this vLLM loader; prefer vllm/vllm-openai:nightly or the vLLM version named on the model card.

explanation.zh: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 加载失败：当前 vLLM 镜像可能不支持该 ModelOpt 权重布局，换 vllm/vllm-openai:nightly 或模型卡指定版本后重试。
explanation.en: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 failed to load: this vLLM image may not support the ModelOpt weight layout; retry with vllm/vllm-openai:nightly or the version named on the model card.

title.zh: DeepGEMM 预热遇到未知的缩放因子变换
title.en: DeepGEMM warm-up hit an unknown scale-factor transformation

hint.zh: 关闭 DeepGEMM（VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0）或换用更新的运行时镜像。
hint.en: Disable DeepGEMM (VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0) or use a newer runtime image.

explanation.zh: 当前镜像的 DeepGEMM 内核不支持该 GPU 架构或量化格式的缩放因子布局。
explanation.en: The DeepGEMM kernels in this image do not support the scale-factor layout of this GPU architecture or quantization.

title.zh: FlashInfer prefill 内核发生 CUDA 崩溃
title.en: The FlashInfer prefill kernel crashed with a CUDA error

hint.zh: 这是 Qwen3.6/NVFP4 在 FlashInfer + FP8 KV prefill 路径上的 CUDA 崩溃风险；dense 模型改用 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN，是否启用 thinking 由客户端请求决定。
hint.en: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 can crash in CUDA on the FlashInfer + FP8 KV prefill path; for dense models use --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN. Thinking is chosen by the client request.

explanation.zh: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 推理退化或 FlashInfer prefill 崩溃：dense 模型使用 TRITON_ATTN，SM12x MoE 使用 flashinfer_b12x + generation-config vllm；thinking 开关应由客户端通过 chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking 控制。
explanation.en: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 generation degraded or the FlashInfer prefill crashed: use TRITON_ATTN for dense models and flashinfer_b12x with generation-config vllm for SM12x MoE; thinking is controlled by the client through chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking.

title.zh: 生成内容退化为循环或重复符号
title.en: Generation degenerated into a loop or repeated symbols

hint.zh: 这是 Qwen3.6/NVFP4 thinking 或生成退化循环；dense 模型使用 TRITON_ATTN，SM12x MoE 使用 flashinfer_b12x + generation-config vllm；thinking 由客户端按需传 chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking 控制。
hint.en: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 thinking or generation degenerated into a loop; use TRITON_ATTN for dense models and flashinfer_b12x with generation-config vllm for SM12x MoE. Thinking is chosen by the client through chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking.

explanation.zh: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 推理退化或 FlashInfer prefill 崩溃：dense 模型使用 TRITON_ATTN，SM12x MoE 使用 flashinfer_b12x + generation-config vllm；thinking 开关应由客户端通过 chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking 控制。
explanation.en: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 generation degraded or the FlashInfer prefill crashed: use TRITON_ATTN for dense models and flashinfer_b12x with generation-config vllm for SM12x MoE; thinking is controlled by the client through chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking.

title.zh: Windows Docker/WSL 不提供 UVA（固定内存）
title.en: UVA (pinned memory) is not available under Windows Docker/WSL

hint.zh: 这是 Windows Docker/WSL 的 pinned memory / UVA 限制；DiffusionGemma 的 V2 runner 需要 UVA，建议换原生 Linux 或使用非 DiffusionGemma 模型。
hint.en: This is the pinned-memory / UVA limit of Windows Docker/WSL; the DiffusionGemma V2 runner needs UVA, so use native Linux or a non-DiffusionGemma model.

explanation.zh: DiffusionGemma NVFP4 当前在 Windows Docker/WSL 路径不稳：优先换原生 Linux + V2 runner，或改跑常规 Qwen/Gemma 模型。
explanation.en: DiffusionGemma NVFP4 is unstable on the Windows Docker/WSL path: prefer native Linux with the V2 runner, or run a regular Qwen/Gemma model.

title.zh: 推理期 CUDA kernel 断言失败
title.en: A CUDA kernel assertion failed during inference

hint.zh: 这是推理期 CUDA kernel 断言，不是端口或显存占满；DiffusionGemma NVFP4 在 Windows Docker/WSL fallback 路径下可能无法稳定生成。
hint.en: This is a CUDA kernel assertion during inference, not a port or memory problem; DiffusionGemma NVFP4 may not generate reliably on the Windows Docker/WSL fallback path.

explanation.zh: DiffusionGemma NVFP4 当前在 Windows Docker/WSL 路径不稳：优先换原生 Linux + V2 runner，或改跑常规 Qwen/Gemma 模型。
explanation.en: DiffusionGemma NVFP4 is unstable on the Windows Docker/WSL path: prefer native Linux with the V2 runner, or run a regular Qwen/Gemma model.

title.zh: 该模型需要执行自定义代码（trust_remote_code）
title.en: This model needs custom code (trust_remote_code)

hint.zh: 该模型可能需要开启 trust_remote_code。
hint.en: This model may need trust_remote_code enabled.

explanation.zh: 模型仓库带有自定义建模代码；开启前请先审阅代码，它会在容器内执行。
explanation.en: The model repository ships custom modeling code; review it before enabling, because it runs inside the container.

title.zh: 端口已被占用
title.en: The port is already in use

hint.zh: 换一个未占用的端口，或停止占用该端口的进程后重试。
hint.en: Pick a free port, or stop the process that holds it, then retry.

explanation.zh: 服务进程无法绑定所选端口，通常是另一个实例或进程已在使用它。
explanation.en: The server could not bind the selected port; usually another instance or process already uses it.

entries.regex: CUDA out of memory|out of memory

title.zh: GPU 显存不足
title.en: The GPU ran out of memory

hint.zh: 降低 max_model_len / max_num_seqs，启用 FP8 KV cache，或降低 gpu-memory-utilization。
hint.en: Lower max_model_len / max_num_seqs, enable the FP8 KV cache, or lower gpu-memory-utilization.

explanation.zh: 显存错误：先切到低显存保守模式或把上下文减半。
explanation.en: Memory error: switch to the low-memory conservative profile or halve the context.

title.zh: 模型仓库需要授权或令牌无效
title.en: The model repository is gated or the token is invalid

hint.zh: 检查 HF_TOKEN 和模型授权。
hint.en: Check HF_TOKEN and your access to the model.

explanation.zh: 授权错误：配置 HF_TOKEN 后重新下载或启动。
explanation.en: Authorization error: set HF_TOKEN, then download or start again.

title.zh: 找不到模型或挂载的文件
title.en: A model or mounted file was not found

hint.zh: 检查模型路径、Docker 挂载目录和文件名。
hint.en: Check the model path, the Docker mount and the file name.

explanation.zh: 路径错误：从模型库选择本地模型并自动填入启动表单。
explanation.en: Path error: pick the local model from the library so the launch form is filled in for you.

title.zh: 日志提到 max_num_batched_tokens
title.en: The log mentions max_num_batched_tokens

hint.zh: 这是 Qwen3.6 混合/Mamba cache align 下的调度 token 上限过低；把 --max-num-batched-tokens 提高到 8192 后重试。
hint.en: The scheduling token limit is too low for hybrid/Mamba cache align (Qwen3.6); raise --max-num-batched-tokens to 8192 and retry.

explanation.zh: Mamba cache align 断言：max_num_batched_tokens 太小，Qwen3.6 MoE/NVFP4 用 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 后重试。
explanation.en: Mamba cache align assertion: max_num_batched_tokens is too small; retry Qwen3.6 MoE/NVFP4 with --max-num-batched-tokens 8192.

title.zh: 日志来自 Qwen3.5/3.6 模型文件
title.en: The log comes from the Qwen3.5/3.6 model file

explanation.zh: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 加载失败：当前 vLLM 镜像可能不支持该 ModelOpt 权重布局，换 vllm/vllm-openai:nightly 或模型卡指定版本后重试。
explanation.en: Qwen3.6/NVFP4 failed to load: this vLLM image may not support the ModelOpt weight layout; retry with vllm/vllm-openai:nightly or the version named on the model card.

title.zh: 日志提到 CUDA
title.en: The log mentions CUDA

hint.zh: 降低 max_model_len / max_num_seqs，启用 FP8 KV cache，或降低 gpu-memory-utilization。
hint.en: Lower max_model_len / max_num_seqs, enable the FP8 KV cache, or lower gpu-memory-utilization.

explanation.zh: 显存错误：先切到低显存保守模式或把上下文减半。
explanation.en: Memory error: switch to the low-memory conservative profile or halve the context.

title.zh: 日志提到文件未找到
title.en: The log mentions something was not found

hint.zh: 检查模型路径、Docker 挂载目录和文件名。
hint.en: Check the model path, the Docker mount and the file name.

explanation.zh: 路径错误：从模型库选择本地模型并自动填入启动表单。
explanation.en: Path error: pick the local model from the library so the launch form is filled in for you.

title.zh: 日志提到 trust_remote_code
title.en: The log mentions trust_remote_code

hint.zh: 该模型可能需要开启 trust_remote_code。
hint.en: This model may need trust_remote_code enabled.

title.zh: 日志提到令牌或授权
title.en: The log mentions a token or gated access

hint.zh: 检查 HF_TOKEN 和模型授权。
hint.en: Check HF_TOKEN and your access to the model.

explanation.zh: 授权错误：配置 HF_TOKEN 后重新下载或启动。
explanation.en: Authorization error: set HF_TOKEN, then download or start again.

title.zh: vLLM 日志提到 GGUF
title.en: The vLLM log mentions GGUF

hint.zh: GGUF 优先用 llama.cpp；若坚持 vLLM，确认 tokenizer/hf-config-path。
hint.en: Prefer llama.cpp for GGUF; if you insist on vLLM, check the tokenizer / hf-config-path.
